channel.title: Just Women's Sports - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Just Women's Sports (justwomenssports.com)

item.title: Lower Seeds Virginia, Notre Dame Shake Up 2026 Women's March Madness Bracket
item.description: Women's March Madness is giving way to Cinderella stories, as Virginia and Notre Dame upset higher seeds to punch tickets to the Sweet 16.

item.title: No. 1 Seeds Dominate Women's March Madness Bracket En Route to Sweet 16
item.description: The NCAA's best are barreling through the Women's March Madness bracket, with all four No. 1 seeds advancing to this year's Sweet 16.

item.title: Champions League Quarterfinals Kick Off in London
item.description: Chelsea and Arsenal will kick off the 2025/26 Champions League quarterfinals on Tuesday, despite shorthanded rosters for the first-leg match.

item.title: North American Tennis Stars Show Off at 2026 Miami Open
item.description: The US and Canada are showing out, with every women's singles quarterfinal at the 2026 Miami Open featuring a North American tennis star.

item.title: 2028 WNBA Expansion Team Cleveland Grows Ownership Group with Monarch Investment
item.description: A full two years out from tipoff, the incoming Cleveland WNBA franchise added high-profile investors to its ownership roster this week.

item.title: Azzi Fudd Set for Record $500K Rookie Salary as No. 1 2026 WNBA Draft Pick
item.description: Azzi Fudd is in line to earn a record $500,000 rookie salary as the No. 1 2026 WNBA Draft pick, highlighting the new CBA's financial impact.

item.title: 2026 WNBA Draft: Dallas Wings Select UConn's Azzi Fudd No. 1 Overall to Join Paige Bueckers
item.description: The 2026 WNBA Draft saw the Dallas Wings select Azzi Fudd No. 1 overall, reuniting the UConn champion with Paige Bueckers in Dallas.

item.title: 2026 WNBA Draft: Golden State Trades Flau'jae Johnson to Seattle in Surprise 1st-Round Swap
item.description: The 2026 WNBA Draft saw Golden State make a surprise swap, trading Flau'jae Johnson to Seattle after taking the LSU star No. 8 overall.

item.title: 2026 WNBA Draft: Minnesota Lynx Pick Olivia Miles No. 2 Overall
item.description: The Minnesota Lynx selected Olivia Miles with the No. 2 pick in the 2026 WNBA Draft, cementing the TCU guard as a top first-round selection.

item.title: USWNT vs Japan: US Prepares to Host Japan in 2nd April Friendly
item.description: USWNT vs Japan kicks off Tuesday on TNT, as US looks to extend a 10-game winning streak via roster rotation in April's second friendly.

item.title: WNBA x Nike 30th Anniversary Retro Line Celebrates 1996 Launch
item.description: Nike launched a WNBA 30th anniversary retro collection celebrating the league's original 1996 logo and colorway with special-edition designs.

item.title: W7F Launches London Edition as Manchester United Headlines May Tournament
item.description: W7F announced its first-ever London Edition, confirming Manchester United and Aston Villa for the May seven-a-side women's soccer tournament.

item.title: 2026 WNBA Draft: Raven Johnson Joins SC Teammate Aliyah Boston in Indiana
item.description: The Fever selected South Carolina Star Raven Johnson 10th overall at the 2026 WNBA Draft, as she reunites with Aliyah Boston in Indiana.

item.title: 2026 WNBA Draft: Hannah Stuelke Goes Undrafted After Record Iowa Run
item.description: Hannah Stuelke went undrafted in the 2026 WNBA Draft, but the former Iowa forward could still have a path to the pros.

item.title: 2026 WNBA Draft: No. 4 Lauren Betts Leads Record 6 UCLA Draft Picks
item.description: Led by No. 4 Lauren Betts, a record six UCLA players made history at the 2026 WNBA Draft — just eight days after winning the NCAA title.
